title: Here's Why the Chevy Bolt is the Uncool Electric Car
summary: Doug DeMuro reviews the 2017 Chevy Bolt, which has a $37,500 base price and 238 miles of range. He looks at why it sells poorly next to the Tesla Model 3, noting its quirks and narrow seats.
why: Cited as a thorough, candid review of the Bolt, particularly for its uncomfortable seats and uncool image.

quote.text: Really really great review from Doug DeMuro here
